description: This file defines the argument parsing and handling mechanisms for Python functions implemented in C++ within the PyTorch project. It includes classes and functions for parsing Python arguments, managing function signatures, handling __torch_function__ overrides, and checking tensor types. It is used to facilitate argument validation, overload resolution, and interoperability between Python and C++ in PyTorch.

classes.name: ParsedArgs
classes.description: Template struct to hold parsed Python arguments in declaration order.

classes.name: PythonArgs
classes.description: Contains bound Python arguments for a function call, along with signature info and utility methods for argument extraction.

classes.name: FunctionParameter
classes.description: Represents a single formal parameter of a Python function, immutable once constructed.

classes.name: FunctionSignature
classes.description: Represents a single valid signature for a Python function, immutable once constructed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses Python args and kwargs into a PythonArgs object based on the signature.

methods.name: has_torch_function
methods.description: Checks if any overloaded arguments have __torch_function__ implementations.

methods.name: get_func_name
methods.description: Returns the function name associated with the PythonArgs.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Retrieves a tensor argument at index i.

methods.name: scalar
methods.description: Retrieves a scalar argument at index i.

methods.name: intlist
methods.description: Retrieves a list of int64_t at index i.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Retrieves a device argument at index i.

methods.name: scalartype
methods.description: Retrieves a scalar type argument at index i.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument at index i.

methods.name: toInt64
methods.description: Converts argument at index i to int64_t.

methods.name: toSymInt
methods.description: Converts argument at index i to c10::SymInt.

methods.name: toBool
methods.description: Converts argument at index i to bool.

methods.name: isNone
methods.description: Checks if argument at index i is None.
